 Falcons flaws exposed against Ravens: Takes with Tre’Shon
 Kevin Knight and Tre’Shon Diaz dive into the film to determine what lessons to take away from Atlanta’s loss to Baltimore.
 by Kevin Knight Oct 16, 2026, 2:00 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 The Falcons lost a tough game in overtime to the depleted but still dangerous Ravens in Week 5. Kevin Knight and Tre’Shon Diaz dive into the film to determine what lessons to take away from Atlanta’s loss, including issues with Michael Penix Jr., the offensive playcalling, and the defense at the end of the game.
